target_section: Section 2 (Directory Structure & File Routing - Schema Definitions & Architecture)
description: Establish gdaschema and gdacore.GDAVocabularyManager as the programmatic generation authorities for physical schema files under schemas/.
payload: * **Schema Definitions & Architecture (`schemas/`):** Base data types (`schemas/defs/`), structural entity definitions (`schemas/entities/`), index schemas (`schemas/indexes/`), and naming tokens (`schemas/naming/_token_registry.json`). Controlled vocabulary taxonomies are programmatically governed by `gdacore.GDAVocabularyManager`, while structural and contract schema definitions are authored and compiled by `gdaschema`. Physical files on disk under `schemas/` (including `_enums.schema.json`) represent generated serialized artifacts emitted and validated by `gdaschema`, rather than independently authored static anchors.
